name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1, replacing scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev. workspace-init is optional: /ossify:start and /ossify:adopt author .ossify/topology.json themselves. Grill/critic ship as /ossify:challenge. /ossify:start onboards, /ossify:adopt takes on an existing repo, /ossify:plan-release and /ossify:plan-spine plan, /ossify:run-spine drives rounds, /ossify:close closes, /ossify:doctor diagnoses, /ossify:wayfinder charts tickets, /ossify:patch ships a shipped defect or a small can't-fake request as a versioned patch, plus the any-repo /ossify:handoff and /ossify:work-pr. Since 1.8.0 /ossify:run-spine accepts an optional --external-executor flag that hands a round's work items to a caller-supplied, provider-neutral in-session procedure; the no-flag command is unchanged. Since 1.14.0 /ossify:run-spine re-enters a started spine on its own, at a round barrier or mid-round, printing a reconcile read-out and halting before any mutation on state it cannot reconcile.
